scope: sync entry and auto-sync toggle exercised with two isolated installs (A/B) on one device

ui.settings_sync_row: shows paired count and this device sync id, with Wait for peer / Sync now
ui.pairing_dialog: shows local fingerprint and sync id, accepts remote fingerprint and remote sync id
ui.auto_sync: checkbox, default off, confirmation dialog, persisted in preferences

manual_sync.dial_result: 同步完成；应用 0 条变更

auto_sync.on_resume_attempt: serve side reported 对端已完成同步 without tapping Sync now

fixed_during_test.pairing_code_symmetry: codes differed because the digest included fingerprints in device order; now sorted + canonical nonce

limitations: Both peers were validation installs; the production APK does not package the sync library yet
Both stores were empty, so the UI run applied 0 records; record convergence is covered by the C6 device suite
Auto-sync is foreground-only and attempts once per process; no background service
Ports are fixed and only loopback/local network is used
